description: Authored anchor-based retrieval benchmark. Never ingest evaluation/. Anchors are expected evidence, not exhaustive relevance labels.

cases.question: How many network devices are modeled across Dubai and London?
cases.expected_answer: Eight: two routers and two switches per site.

cases.question: What is the London user VLAN and its virtual default gateway?
cases.expected_answer: VLAN 120, VIP 10.20.20.1; physical router IPs .2 and .3.

cases.question: Which physical switch interfaces form DXB interswitch Port-channel1?
cases.expected_answer: Gi1/0/2 and Gi1/0/3 at both switch ends.

cases.question: What are the WAN-B subnet and the DXB-R02 and LON-R02 WAN addresses?
Why is WAN-A preferred over WAN-B during normal operation?
cases.expected_answer: Local preference 200 for WAN-A versus 150 for WAN-B, propagated within each site over iBGP.

cases.question: Does BFD configured at 300 ms times 3 guarantee traffic recovery within 900 ms?
cases.expected_answer: No. Approximately 900 ms is expected detection with matching negotiated intervals, not guaranteed end-to-end recovery.

cases.question: Is BFD directly driving VRRP priority in this design?
cases.expected_answer: No. VRRP tracks physical WAN line protocol only; BFD drives BGP recovery.

cases.question: In synthetic FAIL-01, why did the gateway stay on DXB-R01 even though traffic had to use the backup WAN?
cases.expected_answer: Carrier and tracking stayed up so R01 retained priority 120; BFD/BGP rerouted via R02 over the direct interrouter link to WAN-B.

cases.question: In synthetic FAIL-02, what happened to DXB-R01 VRRP priority when its WAN line failed and when did it preempt after restoration?
cases.expected_answer: Priority 120 to 80; R02 takes over. R01 has a configured 30-second preemption wait on recovery; trace times are synthetic.

cases.question: In synthetic FAIL-04, what happened when one DXB interswitch member cable failed?
cases.expected_answer: Po1 remained up with one 1-Gbps member; probes reported no sampled loss, not proof of zero sub-sample loss or tested throughput.

cases.question: In synthetic FAIL-06, why did both Dubai routers become active gateways while same-subnet users on opposite switches lost contact?
cases.expected_answer: Po1 loss partitioned VLANs and VRRP advertisements; R02 timed out while R01 remained master. Cross-segment ARP failed, but remote London reachability remained in the trace.

cases.question: Does TACACS local fallback override an explicit authentication denial?
cases.expected_answer: No. Server timeout/unavailability can trigger fallback; an explicit denial does not.

cases.question: In synthetic FAIL-08, what happened to TACACS+, syslog, SNMP and NTP during the management service failures?
cases.expected_answer: Separate TACACS timeout/fallback/denial tests; LOG-D1 missing locally within observed window; remote TRAP-E1 validation failed after secret mismatch; DXB-R02 selected remote NTP after local server application stopped.

cases.question: Can these configuration files prove BGP is established on real hardware right now?
cases.expected_answer: No. The corpus is fictional and has no live operational state or telemetry.

cases.question: In synthetic FAIL-99, what happened after WAN-A failed?
cases.expected_answer: Scenario missing; do not generate an event account from design guidance.
